  {"step":3,"file":"src/tools/wasm-objdump.cc","function":"dump_file","line":87,"var":"state","code":"ReadBinaryObjdump(data, size, &s_objdump_options, &state)","note":"The binary is parsed in a prepass that populates shared objdump state used by later passes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::BeginElemSegmentInitExpr","line":126,"var":"reading_elem_init_expr_","code":"reading_elem_init_expr_ = true; BeginInitExpr();","note":"When an element segment init expression starts, the reader marks that it is collecting init-expression instructions."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::OnOpcode","line":1872,"var":"current_init_expr_.insts","code":"if (ReadingInitExpr() && opcode != Opcode::End) { current_init_expr_.insts.push_back(i); }","note":"Each opcode in the init expression is appended to the current instruction list, but the instruction payload is only partially populated here."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::OnI32ConstExpr","line":1840,"var":"current_init_expr_.insts.back().imm.i32","code":"current_init_expr_.type = InitExprType::I32; current_init_expr_.insts.back().imm.i32 = value;","note":"For an i32.const init expression, the constant value is written into the last instruction record."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::EndElemSegmentInitExpr","line":134,"var":"EndInitExpr()","code":"return EndInitExpr();","note":"The element-segment init expression is finalized by handing the collected instructions to EndInitExpr."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::EndInitExpr","line":1828,"var":"elem_offset_","code":"reading_elem_init_expr_ = false; InitExprToConstOffset(current_init_expr_, &elem_offset_);","note":"The collected init expression is interpreted as a constant offset for the element segment, and the resulting offset is stored for later printing."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::OnElemSegmentElemExprCount","line":1680,"var":"current_init_expr_","code":"PrintInitExpr(current_init_expr_);","note":"Later, the stored init expression is printed again while processing the element segment, reusing the partially initialized expression object."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/binary-reader-objdump.cc","function":"BinaryReaderObjdump::PrintInitExpr","line":1715,"var":"expr.insts[0]","code":"switch (expr.type) { ... case InitExprType::I32: PrintDetails(\" - init i32=%d\\n\", expr.insts[0].imm.i32);","note":"The sink reads expr.insts[0] and its union field for printing; if the init-expression bookkeeping left the object in an uninitialized state, this dereference triggers the MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
